astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0: listing, answering, verifying and reading cost nothing
astranl.do_not_use_when: you are the responder (self-evidence is not accepted) or you have no capability
astranl.example_intent: Invoice line for L02 at 13.90 excl VAT, delivered on time
astranl.proof_level: buyer-side statement with optional document digest, recorded in the signed log; AstraNL does not see the document
astranl.returns: outcomes price_kept, delivered, on_time; which were applied or conflicting; receipt; responder quality record
astranl.use_when: you hold the buyer capability of an RFQ and the buyer ordered from a responder: record delivery, invoice price or confirmation

annotations.title: Verify a response with buyer evidence

description: Add buyer-side evidence to a response: delivery confirmation, invoice line or customer confirmation. AstraNL records whether the price was kept, the goods delivered and on time, and keeps a verified-quality record per responder. Needs the buyer capability of the RFQ; a responder cannot verify itself. Send a document digest, never the document.

buyer_capability.description: the capability AstraNL issued when it opened the RFQ

name: rfq_verify
